title: The only captioned pages in the frontend name the section "Consignment addresses"; DR1 calls the same section "Consignment parties".

finding.frontend: The five address pickers — place of origin, consignor or exporter, consignee, importer and place of destination — are the only pages in the service with a caption above the h1, and all five read "Consignment addresses". The string is set once at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:42 and rendered at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/party-picker/party-picker.njk:7, with a Welsh pair at copy.cy.js:43. The hub those five pages hang off has no caption, so the section name appears on the spokes and not on the page that names the section.
finding.prototype: DR1 calls this section "Consignment parties", and uses that caption on the address picker (app/views/consignment-address-select.html:40-42), on the roles-and-addresses hub, on the CPH page and on the permanent-address page — four different pages, one section name. The section is named after the people involved in the consignment rather than after their addresses, which is why the CPH page sits inside it.
finding.difference: Change the caption string to "Consignment parties" in src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/addresses/copy/copy.en.js:42 and translate the Welsh pair at copy.cy.js:43 to match. The heading of the hub page itself stays "Consignment addresses" — DR1 keeps that h1 too, so only the caption changes. Do this in the same pass that adds captions to the other 28 pages, because the same four pages that DR1 captions "Consignment parties" include the addresses hub and the CPH page, which have no caption today.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "Consignment addresses" used as a caption anywhere in DR1's root views, or finding "Consignment parties" already rendered above the h1 on a frontend address picker.

relatedTo.why: the same caption pattern; this corrects the five pages that have one, that finding adds the 28 that do not
